miocene.d: from 25 million to 13 million years ago; appearance of grazing mammals

miosis.d: reflex contraction of the sphincter muscle of the iris in response to a bright light (or certain drugs) causing the pupil to become smaller

miotic.d: a drug that causes miosis (constriction of the pupil of the eye)
